citation.journal: Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology

record.population: Literature on ageing across groups, including African American, Asian and Hispanic descent
record.finding: Differences in epidermal melanin make darkly pigmented people more vulnerable to dyspigmentation, while a thicker and more compact dermis makes facial lines less noticeable. Most common signs of ageing in every skin type are dark spots, loss of elasticity and volume, and wrinkles.
